features.description: Render a self-contained interactive HTML graph viewer from canonical SSOT registry graph data.
features.title: Interactive lineage graph HTML export

features.description: Focus the lineage graph on the selected node ego network and support 1-hop through maximum depth traversal.
features.title: Lineage graph ego focus and hop depth

features.description: Lineage graph rendering keeps edges and ribbons visible and applies force layout to all visible SSOT families up to the configured 10000 node cutoff.
features.title: High-volume lineage renderer

features.description: The graph lineage CLI supports an explicit flag that opens the generated HTML artifact with the local platform opener after successful export.
features.title: Lineage graph HTML open flag

features.description: Render visible edges and apply x-axis and y-axis spacing controls without normalizing scale changes away.
features.title: Lineage graph layout scaling

features.description: Show a family legend and package ownership context in the interactive lineage graph.
features.title: Lineage graph legend and package context

features.description: Allow selected visible nodes to be dragged independently from canvas panning.
features.title: Lineage graph node dragging

features.description: Show selected node details, connected edges, and working select/deselect behavior in the interactive lineage graph.
features.title: Lineage graph selected-node detail

features.description: Export PNG and SVG snapshots of the current lineage graph view.
features.title: Lineage graph snapshot export

features.description: Expose fit and zoom controls for the interactive lineage graph viewport.
features.title: Lineage graph viewport controls

features.description: Release metadata, bump scripts, CI, and release workflows include the @ssot-registry/lineage-graph npm package without disrupting Python package targets.
features.title: NPM lineage graph release integration
